evening's.linePrev: In the jingle jangle mornin', I'll come followin' you
evening's.line: Though I know that evening's empire has returned into sand
stanza: Though I know that evening's empire has returned into sand
Left me blindly here to stand, but still not sleeping
My weariness amazes me, I am branded on my feet
I have no one to meet
And my ancient empty street's too dead for dreaming

evening's.songTitle: I Hope That I Don’t Fall in Love with You
evening's.linePrev: Well, if you sit down with this old clown, take that frown and break it
evening's.line: Before the evening's gone away, I think that we can make it
evening's.lineNext: And I hope that I don't fall in love with you
stanza: Well, the room is crowded—people everywhere
And I wonder, should I offer you a chair?
Well, if you sit down with this old clown, take that frown and break it
Before the evening's gone away, I think that we can make it
And I hope that I don't fall in love with you
